urmail_ai_configuration_consent_guard.note: 版本自增、插入默认与 configuration_digest 已承接（前三者由触发器，digest 由 internal/store/sqlite_methods.go 的 refreshAIConfigurationDigest 在每条写入路径后重算）；consent 落库前的 role/actor 判定仍为会话语义
urmail_ai_configuration_consent_guard.app_pending: AI_TENANT_CONSENT_REQUIRED / AI_CLOUD_CONSENT_STALE（BEFORE UPDATE 里对 consent 列变更的 role+actor 校验）→ S2 装饰器；urmail_app 角色下切到 local 时撤销同意由 Go 手写方法按“local 即撤销”的严格方向承接（SQLite 无会话角色）

triggers.name: ai_config_version_keep_or_bump
triggers.when: NEW.configuration_version IS NOT (CASE WHEN NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode OR NEW.provider IS NOT OLD.provider OR NEW.endpoint IS NOT OLD.endpoint OR NEW.model IS NOT OLD.model OR NEW.cloud_scope_hash IS NOT OLD.cloud_scope_hash THEN OLD.configuration_version + 1 ELSE OLD.configuration_version END)
triggers.body:
SELECT CASE WHEN OLD.configuration_version >= 9007199254740991 AND (NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode OR NEW.provider IS NOT OLD.provider OR NEW.endpoint IS NOT OLD.endpoint OR NEW.model IS NOT OLD.model OR NEW.cloud_scope_hash IS NOT OLD.cloud_scope_hash) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'AI_CONFIGURATION_VERSION_EXHAUSTED') END;
UPDATE ai_provider_configs SET configuration_version = CASE WHEN NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode OR NEW.provider IS NOT OLD.provider OR NEW.endpoint IS NOT OLD.endpoint OR NEW.model IS NOT OLD.model OR NEW.cloud_scope_hash IS NOT OLD.cloud_scope_hash THEN OLD.configuration_version + 1 ELSE OLD.configuration_version END WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id

triggers.name: ai_config_insert_defaults
triggers.when: NEW.configuration_version IS NOT 1 OR NEW.tenant_local_only IS NOT 1 OR NEW.cloud_consent_digest IS NOT '' OR NEW.cloud_consent_scope_hash IS NOT '' OR NEW.cloud_consent_by IS NOT NULL OR NEW.cloud_consent_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.cloud_consent_revoked_at IS NOT NULL
triggers.body: UPDATE ai_provider_configs SET configuration_version = 1, tenant_local_only = 1, cloud_consent_digest = '', cloud_consent_scope_hash = '', cloud_consent_by = NULL, cloud_consent_at = NULL, cloud_consent_revoked_at = NULL WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id

urmail_recall_message_identity_guard.note: preview 快照内 copies[] 必须为对象且 copies[].message_guid 为 JSON 字符串（SQLite json_type='text'；json_valid 守卫避免 malformed JSON）；字符集用 GLOB 首位类 + 否定类（SQLite GLOB 的 * 是任意串，不是类重复，不能直译 PG 正则）

triggers.name: recall_message_identity_guard
triggers.when: NEW.status = 'preview' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(CAST(NEW.preview_snapshot AS TEXT)) THEN CAST(NEW.preview_snapshot AS TEXT) END, '$.copies')) copy WHERE copy.type<>'object' OR json_type(copy.value, '$.message_guid') <> 'text' OR length(json_extract(copy.value, '$.message_guid')) < 1 OR length(json_extract(copy.value, '$.message_guid')) > 512 OR json_extract(copy.value, '$.message_guid') NOT GLOB '[A-Za-z0-9]*' OR json_extract(copy.value, '$.message_guid') GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9._,+:=@-]*')

triggers.body: SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tenants WHERE id = NEW.tenant_id AND status IN('active','pending')) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED') ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'DOMAIN_QUOTA_EXCEEDED') END

triggers.name: mailboxes_resource_guard_insert

triggers.body: SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tenants WHERE id = NEW.tenant_id AND status IN('active','pending')) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED') WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domains WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.domain_id AND status='active' AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND provisioning_state='ready') THEN RAISE(ABORT,'DOMAIN_NOT_PROVISIONED') ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'MAILBOX_QUOTA_EXCEEDED') END

triggers.when: COALESCE((SELECT active FROM restore_quarantine), 0)

urmail_retention_confirmation_guard.note: 激活策略必须挂本人、同授权、未过期的已确认 preview（PG 全条件）

triggers.name: retention_confirmation_guard
triggers.when: NEW.active AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retention_previews p WHERE p.id = NEW.confirmed_preview AND p.tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND p.retention_days = NEW.retention_days AND p.created_by = NEW.created_by AND p.authorization_grant_id IS NEW.authorization_grant_id AND p.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND p.expires_at > (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000000))

urmail_retention_management_guard.note: 角色/授权判定为会话语义；策略不可变与停用例外保留为机械
urmail_retention_management_guard.app_pending: RETENTION_MANAGE_REQUIRED 全链（owner/admin 会话、created_by=actor、compliance grant 授权）、preview 生成簿记（candidate_count/digest 计算、15 分钟窗）→ S2 装饰器与 S4 承接；停用例外、preview 过期/确认窗与 DELETE 不可变已机械化

triggers.name: retention_policy_immutable_guard
triggers.when: NEW.active AND (NEW.tenant_id IS NOT OLD.tenant_id OR NEW.retention_days IS NOT OLD.retention_days OR NEW.action IS NOT OLD.action OR NEW.created_by IS NOT OLD.created_by OR NEW.confirmed_preview IS NOT OLD.confirmed_preview OR NEW.authorization_grant_id IS NOT OLD.authorization_grant_id)

triggers.name: retention_preview_stale_guard
triggers.when: (NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.tenant_id IS NOT OLD.tenant_id OR NEW.retention_days IS NOT OLD.retention_days OR NEW.candidate_count IS NOT OLD.candidate_count OR NEW.candidate_digest IS NOT OLD.candidate_digest OR NEW.created_by IS NOT OLD.created_by OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at OR NEW.expires_at IS NOT OLD.expires_at OR NEW.authorization_grant_id IS NOT OLD.authorization_grant_id) OR OLD.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.confirmed_at IS NULL OR OLD.expires_at <= (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000000)

urmail_setting_limit.note: 纯 SQL 函数（settings 行谓词 limit 读取），无触发器——已内联进 urmail_resource_guard 触发器

urmail_suppression_no_weaken.note: suppression 身份不可变；强 reason 不得弱化为 manual

triggers.name: suppression_no_weaken_guard
triggers.when: NEW.tenant_id IS NOT OLD.tenant_id OR NEW.email IS NOT OLD.email OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at OR NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id

triggers.name: suppression_reason_guard
triggers.when: OLD.reason <> 'manual' AND NEW.reason IS NOT OLD.reason

urmail_panel_credential_version.note: panel 凭据代数自增：密码轮换或 MFA 开关/密钥变更时 +1；rehash 路径（urmail.password_rehash=true）不自增，避免无谓注销会话。PG 为 BEFORE UPDATE 改 NEW，SQLite 无 NEW 赋值，改为 AFTER UPDATE 回写。
urmail_panel_credential_version.app_pending: current_setting('urmail.password_rehash') 会话变量由 S2 装饰器/S5 适配器提供（与 PlatformRehashPanelPassword 的 set_config 同源）

triggers.name: panel_credential_version
triggers.when: (NEW.password_hash IS NOT OLD.password_hash AND current_setting('urmail.password_rehash',true) IS NOT 'true') OR NEW.mfa_enabled IS NOT OLD.mfa_enabled OR NEW.mfa_secret IS NOT OLD.mfa_secret
triggers.body: UPDATE users SET credential_version = OLD.credential_version + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id
